description: List the Washington State Register (WSR) rule-making FILINGS that affected a Washington Administrative Code (WAC) section or chapter — the amendment history as agency actions: WSR number, filing type (Permanent Rule, Proposal Original Notice, Emergency Rule, Expedited Rule Making, Preproposal Statement of Inquiry…), date filed, and a link to the filing text. Newest first. Use for "when was WAC 296-800-110 last amended", "is there a pending proposal to change chapter 458-20 WAC", or to trace a rule's rule-making record. Keyless.
name: wa_wac_filings
title: Wa Wac Filings
